_comment: Claude API list prices, USD per million tokens, used only to estimate Claude spend in Grafana: Claude Platform spans carry tokens, not cost. Same table as crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/pricing.rs. A five-minute cache write costs 1.25x input, a one-hour write 2x input. `match` is an anchored regex for gen_ai.response.model (a release-date suffix is allowed after it); keep it short, because Grafana Cloud's TraceQL parser fails on some queries over 1024 characters. OpenRouter spans report their own cost and need no table.
crok_comment: Standard API list prices, USD per million tokens, for the calls of crok 2.0.0 and older: they carry tokens but no cost of their own (crok.cost.usd), so the dashboards price them here. Newer crok prices every call itself with the same table, crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/pricing.rs, so keep the two alike. Only the priced models those releases call through Codex (ChatGPT sign-in), DeepSeek and GLM are listed: every one costs each dashboard two more queries. `provider` is gen_ai.provider.name, `match` an anchored regex for gen_ai.request.model. These providers bill cache writes as input and crok's spans of them carry none. DeepSeek charges half its price off-peak (`off_peak`); TraceQL cannot tell the hour of a call, so these calls are priced at the off-peak rate, which holds 133 of a week's 168 hours (peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday). The Codex models' 272K context window stays under OpenAI's long-context tier (prompts over 272K), so that tier never applies.
